===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Freescale (NXP)]] ''QorIQ'' [https://www.nxp.com/products/processors-and-microcontrollers/applications-processors/qoriq-platforms/t-series/qoriq-t1024-14-and-t1023-13-dual-and-single-core-communications-processors:T1024?fsrch=1&sr=1&pageNum=1 T1024NS] @1.2GHz :Dual Core e5500 PowerPC (64-bit) *Memory: 2GB (DDR3L) SDRAM *Storage: 4MB (SPI) Flash, 16GB (mSATA) *Network: 4x GbE, 1x GbE ports w/ 802.3at PoE *USB: 2x USB 2.0 ports *Power: 54V/1.2A via 3-pin DIN
